chapters.label: Wembley, 1986
chapters.text: Wembley, 1986, the FA Cup final: Liverpool, in red, against Everton, in blue. Everton lead, until Jan Mølby slides a pass through. Ian Rush races clear, steps round the keeper, and scores!

chapters.label: Onside
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Rush times his run, so he stays onside. The keeper, Mimms, comes out. One touch to the side, and he slots it in.

chapters.label: One-all
chapters.text: One-all! Rush scored again later, and Liverpool won three-one.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: time your run so you are onside, then take the ball round the keeper.
